$comment: Generated by _design/tools/map_gen.py (edit there, then run it and _harness/probe_maps.ts). Layout truth for the sim, the Blender scene and the minimap; landmark and art brief: _design/maps/map_rift_landmarks.md.
name: Hourfall
desc: The carved dial itself. Three roads run west to east between the Glass Belfry and the Lamp Dome, crossed by the Noonline that runs north and south through the Seat.

textures.$comment: painted tiling textures by role (tools/terrain_textures.py; render/terrain.ts maps each painting's mean onto the band colour, alpha = height)

props.$comment: scatter props (art/blender/props/scatter.py): vertex-coloured, real size, origin at the ground contact; render/terrain.ts instances them on its procedural spots. Dialwood trees (clumps of matte painted fan plates, ≥ 20 per crown, ≤ 750 tris, ≤ 3.4 m in game; COLOR_0.a is the gloss mask, 0 everywhere since r12 M11: the renderer keeps roughness ≥ 0.75 and sways the crowns ≤ 4 cm), fallen hour-tick stones at the cliff feet (rock: ≤ 0.4 m in game, they stand on walkable floor) and small tick fragments

propValue.$comment: r12 B5 value rebase: linear multipliers on the authored props' colours so they land in tokens grade.maps.rift.valueLstar (render/terrain.ts propValue)

terrain.$comment: Art hints (free-form; the sim reads none of it). colors: refs for render/terrain.ts's procedural fallback. noonline: floor polygons of the two Noonline halves. tokens.json grade.maps.rift.valueLstar is the value law; _design/maps/map_rift_landmarks.md is the brief.

standingShadow.edge: hard, engraved; keeps colour under fog of war

quadrantTint.$comment: r12 M14: a ±4 % per-channel hue tint per Dialwood quadrant (luminance kept; render/terrain.ts quadUniforms), blended over ±8 m across the Noonline (x 85) and the Mid road (y 55), on the jungle floor, the Needlegrass and the crowns, never on a road: Elevenmark (NW) a cool periwinkle, Twomark (NE) a dusk mauve, Sevenmark (SW) a sage, Fourmark (SE) an ochre

hourLines.note: Dialwood paths follow the hour-ring and two hour-lines per quadrant (Baseward, Rimward)

landmarks.name: Glass Belfry
landmarks.note: Aubade base, beyond the west edge (art/blender/maps/landmarks_art2.py): coursed chalk in three stages (a glazed lancet on each face of the first, open pointed arches on corner piers above), buttress pinnacles with dawnglass shards, blued-steel bands, the dawnglass bell-lantern (neutral cool, emissive 0.5) under a steel-ribbed spire; its chalk-flagged court fills the rim 44-66

landmarks.name: Lamp Dome
landmarks.note: Serenade base, beyond the east edge (art/blender/maps/landmarks_art2.py): a ribbed ironstone dome on a coursed sandstone drum (ironstone bands, twelve round-arched lampresin windows between pilasters), a lampresin oculus (emissive 0.8); its sandstone-flagged court fills the rim 44-66

ambient.$comment: r12 M14 ambient life (render/ambient.ts; the sim reads none of it). effects: T0 amb_* defs (content/vfx.json, tools/vfx/ambient_defs.py) at [x, y, height above the ground]; critters: art/blender/props/critters.py rigs at seeded spots [x, y, radius]; props: art/blender/props/ambient_props.py at [x, y, rotation deg] (sway = metres at the cloth's free edge; fx = an effect on every placement). Nothing sits on a lane, a camp, an objective's pit (10 m: Sunsplinter's and Longshade's), a fountain or a shop (tools/build_content.ts checks); the map is mirrored across the noon line.
